name: Nour
self_text: Hi, I’m Nour, early 20s, Japanese, and I love urban gardening in my free time. I play on console in Skyforge Arena, always in ranked matches where I take a damage role. I’m happy to coach others and share tips. I’m free on Saturday mornings for matches or coaching sessions. I enjoy the fast pace of the game and helping teammates improve. Looking forward to connecting with fellow players who value teamwork and skill growth.

requests.request_text: I need you to be a support role or a flexible role (I can fill any position), only if you can adapt to that; I'd strongly prefer that you are available Saturday morning, though that's not a requirement.
